issue.title: Guide: stop a stalled agent and keep its work with Agent Hijack
issue.description:
Proposed by land phase sase-1qz.11 (note #7) of epic sase-1qz (Agent Hijack, plan:202611/agent_hijack.md). Per the docs routing rule, the land phase recorded a guide candidate instead of appending hijack narrative to docs/guides/recover-interrupted-agent.md.

Hijack is now user-visible (,k, the kill dialog's h, `sase agent hijack`, and the recovery panel). Its facts live on Reference pages (docs/reference/agents/agent-sessions.md#hijack-recovery, docs/reference/tui/agents-tab-modes.md#hijack-recovery-panel, docs/reference/agents/workspaces.md). Decide whether "stop a stalled agent and keep its work" is its own user goal; if so, write a short Guide that links those Reference pages instead of restating them, and cross-link it from the interrupted-agent guide.

task_type_fields.proposal: Decide whether hijack recovery is its own user goal and, if so, write a short Guide that links the hijack Reference sections instead of restating them, cross-linked from recover-interrupted-agent.md.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Docs routing sends new capabilities to Reference first and records new user goals as guide candidates; the hijack epic only owned Reference updates.
